private Map<EventType, JobSummaryEventHandler> buildJobSummaryEventHandlers() {
    Map<EventType, JobSummaryEventHandler> map = new HashMap<EventType, JobSummaryEventHandler>();
    map.put(EventType.JOB_SUBMITTED, new JobSummaryEventHandler() {
      @Override
      public void handle(HistoryEvent event, JobSummary summary, JobId jobId) {
        JobSubmittedEvent jse = (JobSubmittedEvent) event;
        summary.setUser(jse.getUserName());
        summary.setQueue(jse.getJobQueueName());
        summary.setJobSubmitTime(jse.getSubmitTime());
        summary.setJobName(jse.getJobName());
      }
    });
    map.put(EventType.NORMALIZED_RESOURCE, new JobSummaryEventHandler() {
      @Override
      public void handle(HistoryEvent event, JobSummary summary, JobId jobId) {
        NormalizedResourceEvent nre = (NormalizedResourceEvent) event;
        if (nre.getTaskType() == TaskType.MAP) {
          summary.setResourcesPerMap(nre.getMemory());
        } else if (nre.getTaskType() == TaskType.REDUCE) {
          summary.setResourcesPerReduce(nre.getMemory());
        }
      }
    });
    map.put(EventType.JOB_INITED, new JobSummaryEventHandler() {
      @Override
      public void handle(HistoryEvent event, JobSummary summary, JobId jobId) {
        JobInitedEvent jie = (JobInitedEvent) event;
        summary.setJobLaunchTime(jie.getLaunchTime());
      }
    });
    map.put(EventType.MAP_ATTEMPT_STARTED, new JobSummaryEventHandler() {
      @Override
      public void handle(HistoryEvent event, JobSummary summary, JobId jobId) {
        TaskAttemptStartedEvent tase = (TaskAttemptStartedEvent) event;
        if (summary.getFirstMapTaskLaunchTime() == 0) {
          summary.setFirstMapTaskLaunchTime(tase.getStartTime());
        }
      }
    });
    map.put(EventType.REDUCE_ATTEMPT_STARTED, new JobSummaryEventHandler() {
      @Override
      public void handle(HistoryEvent event, JobSummary summary, JobId jobId) {
        TaskAttemptStartedEvent tase = (TaskAttemptStartedEvent) event;
        if (summary.getFirstReduceTaskLaunchTime() == 0) {
          summary.setFirstReduceTaskLaunchTime(tase.getStartTime());
        }
      }
    });
    JobSummaryEventHandler unsuccessfulHandler = new JobSummaryEventHandler() {
      @Override
      public void handle(HistoryEvent event, JobSummary summary, JobId jobId) {
        JobUnsuccessfulCompletionEvent juce = (JobUnsuccessfulCompletionEvent) event;
        summary.setJobStatus(juce.getStatus());
        summary.setNumFinishedMaps(context.getJob(jobId).getTotalMaps());
        summary.setNumFinishedReduces(context.getJob(jobId).getTotalReduces());
        summary.setJobFinishTime(juce.getFinishTime());
        setSummarySlotSeconds(summary, context.getJob(jobId).getAllCounters());
      }
    };
    map.put(EventType.JOB_FAILED, unsuccessfulHandler);
    map.put(EventType.JOB_KILLED, unsuccessfulHandler);
    map.put(EventType.JOB_FINISHED, new JobSummaryEventHandler() {
      @Override
      public void handle(HistoryEvent event, JobSummary summary, JobId jobId) {
        JobFinishedEvent jfe = (JobFinishedEvent) event;
        summary.setJobFinishTime(jfe.getFinishTime());
        summary.setNumFinishedMaps(jfe.getFinishedMaps());
        summary.setNumFailedMaps(jfe.getFailedMaps());
        summary.setNumFinishedReduces(jfe.getFinishedReduces());
        summary.setNumFailedReduces(jfe.getFailedReduces());
        if (summary.getJobStatus() == null) {
          summary.setJobStatus(org.apache.hadoop.mapreduce.JobStatus.State.SUCCEEDED.toString());
        }
        setSummarySlotSeconds(summary, jfe.getTotalCounters());
      }
    });
    return map;
  }

@Private
  public void handleEvent(JobHistoryEvent event) {
    synchronized (lock) {
      EventType eventType = event.getHistoryEvent().getEventType();

      PreEventHandler preHandler = preEventHandlers.get(eventType);
      if (preHandler != null) {
        preHandler.handle(event);
      }

      MetaInfo mi = fileMap.get(event.getJobID());
      processEventCore(event, mi);

      PostEventHandler postHandler = postEventHandlers.get(eventType);
      if (postHandler != null) {
        postHandler.handle(event, mi);
      }
    }
  }

  private void processEventCore(JobHistoryEvent event, MetaInfo mi) {
    try {
      HistoryEvent historyEvent = event.getHistoryEvent();
      if (!(historyEvent instanceof NormalizedResourceEvent)) {
        mi.writeEvent(historyEvent);
      }
      processEventForJobSummary(historyEvent, mi.getJobSummary(), event.getJobID());
      if (timelineClient != null) {
        processEventForTimelineServer(historyEvent, event.getJobID(), event.getTimestamp());
      }
      if (LOG.isDebugEnabled()) {
        LOG.debug("In HistoryEventHandler " + historyEvent.getEventType());
      }
    } catch (IOException e) {
      LOG.error("Error writing History Event: " + event.getHistoryEvent(), e);
      throw new YarnRuntimeException(e);
    }
  }

          + "Server", ex);
    } catch (YarnException ex) {
      LOG.error("Error putting entity " + tEntity.getEntityId() + " to Timeline"
          + "Server", ex);

private <M extends HttpMethod> int exec(M method) throws IOException {
  final HttpClient client = createHttpClient();
  int statusCode = execWithDebugOutput(method, client);
  statusCode = attemptKeystoneAuthIfNeeded(method, client, statusCode);
  statusCode = reauthenticateIfNeeded(method, client, statusCode);
  return statusCode;
}

private HttpClient createHttpClient() {
  final HttpClient client = new HttpClient();
  if (proxyHost != null) {
    client.getParams().setParameter(ConnRoutePNames.DEFAULT_PROXY,
            new HttpHost(proxyHost, proxyPort));
  }
  return client;
}

private <M extends HttpMethod> int attemptKeystoneAuthIfNeeded(M method, HttpClient client, int statusCode) throws IOException {
  if (isKeystoneAuthRetryable(statusCode, method)) {
    if (LOG.isDebugEnabled()) {
      LOG.debug("Operation failed with status " + statusCode + " attempting keystone auth");
    }
    useKeystoneAuthentication = true;
    final AuthPostMethod authentication = (AuthPostMethod) method;
    authentication.setRequestEntity(getAuthenticationRequst(keystoneAuthRequest));
    statusCode = execWithDebugOutput(method, client);
  }
  return statusCode;
}

private <M extends HttpMethod> boolean isKeystoneAuthRetryable(int statusCode, M method) {
  return (statusCode == HttpStatus.SC_UNAUTHORIZED
          || statusCode == HttpStatus.SC_BAD_REQUEST)
          && method instanceof AuthPostMethod
          && !useKeystoneAuthentication;
}

private <M extends HttpMethod> int reauthenticateIfNeeded(M method, HttpClient client, int statusCode) throws IOException {
  if (statusCode == HttpStatus.SC_UNAUTHORIZED) {
    if (method instanceof AuthPostMethod) {
      throw new SwiftAuthenticationFailedException(authRequest.toString(),
                                                   "auth",
                                                   authUri,
                                                   method);
    }
    if (LOG.isDebugEnabled()) {
      LOG.debug("Reauthenticating");
    }
    authenticate();
    if (LOG.isDebugEnabled()) {
      LOG.debug("Retrying original request");
    }
    statusCode = execWithDebugOutput(method, client);
  }
  return statusCode;
}

private static final Map<Integer, ExceptionFactory> EXCEPTION_FACTORIES =
    new HashMap<Integer, ExceptionFactory>();

static {
  EXCEPTION_FACTORIES.put(SC_NOT_FOUND, new ExceptionFactory() {
    @Override
    public IOException create(URI uri, HttpMethod method, String errorMessage, SwiftRestClient client) {
      return new FileNotFoundException("Operation " + method.getName() + " on " + uri);
    }
  });
  EXCEPTION_FACTORIES.put(SC_BAD_REQUEST, new ExceptionFactory() {
    @Override
    public IOException create(URI uri, HttpMethod method, String errorMessage, SwiftRestClient client) {
      return new SwiftBadRequestException("Bad request against " + uri, method.getName(), uri, method);
    }
  });
  EXCEPTION_FACTORIES.put(SC_REQUESTED_RANGE_NOT_SATISFIABLE, new ExceptionFactory() {
    @Override
    public IOException create(URI uri, HttpMethod method, String errorMessage, SwiftRestClient client) {
      StringBuilder errorText = new StringBuilder(method.getStatusText());
      Header requestContentLen = method.getRequestHeader(HEADER_CONTENT_LENGTH);
      if (requestContentLen != null) {
        errorText.append(" requested ").append(requestContentLen.getValue());
      }
      Header availableContentRange = method.getResponseHeader(HEADER_CONTENT_RANGE);
      if (requestContentLen != null) {
        errorText.append(" available ").append(availableContentRange.getValue());
      }
      return new EOFException(errorText.toString());
    }
  });
  EXCEPTION_FACTORIES.put(SC_UNAUTHORIZED, new ExceptionFactory() {
    @Override
    public IOException create(URI uri, HttpMethod method, String errorMessage, SwiftRestClient client) {
      return new SwiftAuthenticationFailedException(
          "Operation not authorized- current access token =" + client.getToken(),
          method.getName(),
          uri,
          method);
    }
  });
  ExceptionFactory throttledFactory = new ExceptionFactory() {
    @Override
    public IOException create(URI uri, HttpMethod method, String errorMessage, SwiftRestClient client) {
      return new SwiftThrottledRequestException(
          "Client is being throttled: too many requests",
          method.getName(),
          uri,
          method);
    }
  };
  EXCEPTION_FACTORIES.put(SwiftProtocolConstants.SC_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS_429, throttledFactory);
  EXCEPTION_FACTORIES.put(SwiftProtocolConstants.SC_THROTTLED_498, throttledFactory);
}

private static class EndpointSelection {
  final URI endpointURI;
  final Endpoint swiftEndpoint;
  final StringBuilder catalogList;
  final StringBuilder regionList;

  private EndpointSelection(URI endpointURI,
                            Endpoint swiftEndpoint,
                            StringBuilder catalogList,
                            StringBuilder regionList) {
    this.endpointURI = endpointURI;
    this.swiftEndpoint = swiftEndpoint;
    this.catalogList = catalogList;
    this.regionList = regionList;
  }
}

/**
 * Search the service catalog for a Swift endpoint matching the configured region.
 *
 * @param serviceCatalog catalog of services
 * @return selection containing the chosen endpoint and diagnostic lists
 */
private EndpointSelection findSwiftEndpoint(List<Catalog> serviceCatalog) {
  URI endpointURI = null;
  Endpoint swiftEndpoint = null;
  StringBuilder catList = new StringBuilder();
  StringBuilder regionList = new StringBuilder();

  for (Catalog catalog : serviceCatalog) {
    String name = catalog.getName();
    String type = catalog.getType();
    String descr = String.format("[%s: %s]; ", name, type);
    catList.append(descr);
    if (LOG.isDebugEnabled()) {
      LOG.debug("Catalog entry " + descr);
    }
    if (isSwiftCatalog(catalog)) {
      if (LOG.isDebugEnabled()) {
        LOG.debug("Found swift catalog as " + name + " => " + type);
      }
      for (Endpoint endpoint : catalog.getEndpoints()) {
        String endpointRegion = endpoint.getRegion();
        URI publicURL = endpoint.getPublicURL();
        URI internalURL = endpoint.getInternalURL();
        descr = String.format("[%s => %s / %s]; ",
                              endpointRegion,
                              publicURL,
                              internalURL);
        regionList.append(descr);
        if (LOG.isDebugEnabled()) {
          LOG.debug("Endpoint " + descr);
        }
        URI selected = selectEndpointURI(endpoint);
        if (selected != null) {
          endpointURI = selected;
          swiftEndpoint = endpoint;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return new EndpointSelection(endpointURI, swiftEndpoint, catList, regionList);
}

private String buildNoEndpointMessage(EndpointSelection selection) {
  return "Could not find swift service from auth URL "
         + authUri
         + " and region '" + region + "'. "
         + "Categories: " + selection.catalogList
         + ((selection.regionList.length() > 0) ?
            ("regions: " + selection.regionList)
            : "No regions");
}

/**
 * Build the object-location URI from the chosen Swift endpoint.
 *
 * @param endpointURI swift endpoint URI
 * @param swiftEndpoint swift endpoint details
 * @return object location URI
 * @throws SwiftException if the URI cannot be constructed
 */
private URI buildObjectLocation(URI endpointURI, Endpoint swiftEndpoint) throws SwiftException {
  String path = SWIFT_OBJECT_AUTH_ENDPOINT + swiftEndpoint.getTenantId();
  String host = endpointURI.getHost();
  try {
    return new URI(endpointURI.getScheme(),
                   null,
                   host,
                   endpointURI.getPort(),
                   path,
                   null,
                   null);
  } catch (URISyntaxException e) {
    throw new SwiftException("object endpoint URI is incorrect: "
                             + endpointURI
                             + " + " + path,
                             e);
  }
}

    /**

    */
    private static Object performBinaryOperation(Object lhs, Object rhs, int kind)

    {
        if(lhs.getClass() != rhs.getClass())
            throw new EvalError("type mismatch in operator.  " 
			+ lhs.getClass() + " cannot be used with " + rhs.getClass() );

        try {
            return binaryOperationImpl(lhs, rhs, kind);
        } catch (ArithmeticException e) {
            throw new TargetError("Arithemetic Exception in binary op", e);
        }
    }

    */
    private static Object wrapBinaryResult(Object result, Class lhsOrgType, Class rhsOrgType)

            return new Primitive(result);
        else
            return result;
    }

    static Object binaryOperationImpl( Object lhs, Object rhs, int kind )
        throws EvalError
	{
        if(lhs instanceof Boolean)
            return booleanBinaryOperation((Boolean)lhs, (Boolean)rhs, kind);
        else if(lhs instanceof Integer)
            return intBinaryOperation( (Integer)lhs, (Integer)rhs, kind );
        else if(lhs instanceof Long)
            return longBinaryOperation((Long)lhs, (Long)rhs, kind);
        else if(lhs instanceof Float)
            return floatBinaryOperation((Float)lhs, (Float)rhs, kind);
        else if(lhs instanceof Double)
            return doubleBinaryOperation( (Double)lhs, (Double)rhs, kind);
        else
            throw new EvalError("Invalid types in binary operator" );
	}

        boolean rhs = B2.booleanValue();

                return new Boolean(lhs != rhs);

            case BOOL_ORX:

            case BOOL_AND:
            case BOOL_ANDX:

            default:

            case GT: case GTX:
                return new Boolean(lhs > rhs);

            case LE: case LEX:
                return new Boolean(lhs <= rhs);
            case GE: case GEX:
                return new Boolean(lhs >= rhs);
            case NE:

        switch(kind)
        {
            case PLUS:
                return new Long(lhs + rhs);
            case MINUS:
                return new Long(lhs - rhs);
            case STAR:
                return new Long(lhs * rhs);
            case SLASH:
                return new Long(lhs / rhs);
            case MOD:
                return new Long(lhs % rhs);
            default:
                throw new InterpreterError("Unimplemented long arithmetic operator");

            case RUNSIGNEDSHIFT: case RUNSIGNEDSHIFTX:

            case MINUS:
                return new Long(lhs - rhs);

            case STAR:
                return new Long(lhs * rhs);

            case SLASH:
                return new Long(lhs / rhs);

            case MOD:
                return new Long(lhs % rhs);

            default:
                throw new InterpreterError("Unimplemented long arithmetic operator");

    private static Object longBitwiseOperation(long lhs, long rhs, int kind)
